sources.title: Introducing OpenAI o3 and o4-mini
sources.evidence: April 16, 2025 announcement explicitly makes o3 available that day to ChatGPT Plus, Pro and Team and through Chat Completions and Responses APIs. It identifies o3 as an o-series model trained to reason with reinforcement learning, with image analysis and tool use. The later o3-pro update is a separate variant.

sources.title: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete original 33-page PDF on October 27, 2026 and read sections 1–2 plus parameter, architecture and training matches throughout the fresh extracted text. It identifies o3 and o4-mini as o-series models trained with large-scale reinforcement learning, but gives no nominal total or active parameter count and no counted named base from which to infer one. The family/training description does not establish shared size or dense/MoE topology.

sources.title: o3 model reference
sources.evidence: The complete Markdown reference identifies o3, default snapshot o3-2025-04-16, deprecated status, 200,000-token context, 100,000-token output limit, text/image input, text output, reasoning tokens, function calling, file uploads and prompt caching. Hosted image generation is a Responses tool; the native image-generation endpoint is unsupported. This documents specifications, not a tested live endpoint.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: The archived guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6 and mentions o3 when explaining caching support. Section 2.1 describes forward passes through Transformer layers and cached attention key/value projections across layers and heads. Combined with exact o3 prompt-caching support, this permits a qualified broad Transformer inference, without revealing dense/MoE topology or parameter counts.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: The complete guide explains that PDF inputs to vision-capable models are represented using extracted text and page images. Together with o3 image input and file-upload support, this supports PDF as an accepted API input format rather than a separate native modality.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: The service agreement grants limited rights to use the API and retains OpenAI ownership of its services. Together with the hosted release and model documentation, this supports a descriptive proprietary classification, not a named open-weight license.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Reopened the full GPT-5 report on October 27, 2026 (arXiv v2, May 1, 2026) and searched its complete text for parameter and architecture disclosures. Table 1 calls GPT-5 models successors to o3/o3 Pro; exact o3 columns in later tables give evaluation scores, not total or active counts. Successor naming and helpful-only experimental checkpoints establish no counted base lineage for production o3.

sources.title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
sources.evidence: Reopened the full 35-page original model-team report on October 27, 2026. Section 2 and Table 1 explicitly give total/active counts only for gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b (116.83B/5.13B and 20.91B/3.61B); exact o3 comparisons in figures and Table 2 are benchmark scores without o3 counts. Their similar reinforcement-learning techniques and performance do not identify o3 as a variant of either counted gpt-oss model.

sources.title: Detecting and reducing scheming in AI models
sources.evidence: Reopened the original September 17, 2025 research page on October 27, 2026. It explicitly describes training versions of o3 and o4-mini with deliberative alignment and inspecting their reasoning, but states no model parameter size. The experimental relationship supplies no counted base for either a nominal total or active inference.

sources.title: Deprecations
sources.evidence: The June 11, 2026 notice explicitly lists o3 and o3-2025-04-16 for removal on December 11, 2026. On the audit date this is a scheduled shutdown, separate from retired o3-mini and o3-deep-research variants. No API request was made to test endpoint operation.

sources.title: Models.dev o3 record
sources.evidence: Read the exact upstream record as a discovery lead. Its release date, context and capabilities were checked against primary sources; its description and lack of technical architecture details are not treated as independent evidence.

sources.title: All models
sources.evidence: The current documentation index lists o3 as a deprecated reasoning model separately from the open-weight gpt-oss section, o3-pro, o3-mini and o3-deep-research. This corroborates the hosted distribution and exact model identity.

sources.title: Competitive Programming with Large Reasoning Models
sources.evidence: Freshly opened the original February 2025 model-team report on October 27, 2026. The abstract and sections 4–5 explicitly evaluate an early o3 checkpoint; greater RL/training compute and o1-to-o3 progress are not a parameter count or a named counted-base relationship. No nominal total or active o3 specification is given, and the early checkpoint is not assumed identical to the April API release.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the original May 2025 model-team report on October 27, 2026 and checked its Activated Params comparisons and exact o3 mentions. o3 appears in the introduction and launch citation; the relevant OpenAI comparison columns instead identify o1 and o3-mini. No total or activated count for exact o3 is supplied. Counts or conventions for another named model are not transferred.

sources.title: Can Large Reasoning Models Reason about Spatial Relations?
sources.evidence: Freshly opened the author-hosted original 11-page paper on October 27, 2026. Table 1 on PDF page 4 identifies exact o3-2025-04-16-high and marks Number of Parameters as Undisclosed; the same table explicitly supplies activated parameters for DeepSeek-R1 but none for o3. This is an original empirical comparison, not an OpenAI disclosure, and corroborates only the absence of a usable count in that table.

sources.title: VLM Reality Check: A Causal Counterfactual Benchmark for Diagnosing Cognitive Biases in Vision-Language Models — Supplementary Material
sources.evidence: Fresh search located Table 2; after the web reader returned 403, a direct request returned HTTP 200 and the full original PDF was extracted on October 27, 2026. The o3 row explicitly labels its Approx. Parameters cell Undisclosed (~500B est.). Section 9 and the table give no o3-specific count citation or estimation method; no active count is given. This unsupported estimate is not adopted as a nominal specification or an established research counting convention. A failed fetch was not used as evidence of absence.

name.note: The exact public model name and undated API alias are o3; o3-pro, o3-mini and o3-deep-research are separate variants.

developer.note: OpenAI announced, trained and serves this model.

family.note: Uses o3 as the catalog generation/series grouping within OpenAI’s broader o-series. The launch and exact model references identify o3, while the model index separately names o3-pro, o3-mini and o3-deep-research. This grouping follows model naming and does not assert shared weights, parameter counts or topology among the variants.

release_date.note: The announcement explicitly grants same-day public access through paid ChatGPT plans and the API. This is release availability rather than an earlier preview announcement or a later organization rollout.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted ChatGPT/API access under service terms; the primary model index distinguishes the released open-weight gpt-oss models from o3.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted proprietary model, not an SPDX or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 checks found no supported nominal total for exact o3 or an explicitly identified counted base. The original card and later OpenAI model-team comparisons give no o3 count; GeoAI Table 1 labels the exact April snapshot Undisclosed. The CVPR supplement explicitly labels its ~500B figure an estimate without o3 count provenance or method, so it is not adopted. This conclusion does not require an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Separately rechecked nominal active/activated counts in original and later model-team tables on October 27. No exact o3 active figure or supported counted-base inference was found. gpt-oss active counts belong to those models; Qwen3 compares other OpenAI identities, and GeoAI gives no o3 activated count. No active value is inferred from a total estimate, dense-model assumptions, performance or reasoning effort.

architecture.note: Qualified broad inference: exact o3 supports prompt caching; the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 engineering guide explicitly includes o3 and describes Transformer attention/KV layers. The original card and training research do not disclose dense versus MoE, layer counts or other production topology.

context_window.note: The exact model reference documents a 200,000-token context window separately from its 100,000-token maximum output.

modalities.note: Native modalities are text/image input and text output. PDF is retained as an accepted API file format represented as extracted text and page images. Hosted image generation does not imply native image output.

reasoning.note: The launch and original card describe reinforcement-learned reasoning; the exact reference confirms reasoning-token support.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly documented for exact o3. Current hosted-tool support is distinguished from the original launch schedule and does not change native output modalities.

description.value: OpenAI o-series reasoning model with text and image input, text output, and function calling.
description.note: Replaces promotional and imprecise wording with documented family, native modalities and function-calling capability.

patch.description: OpenAI o-series reasoning model with text and image input, text output, and function calling.

sources.label: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card

patch.notes: The o3 alias is documented as pointing to o3-2025-04-16. It is deprecated, with API removal scheduled for December 11, 2026; endpoint operation was not tested. Transformer is a broad inference from exact o3 prompt-caching support and OpenAI's applicable pre-GPT-5.6 KV-cache explanation, not a disclosed topology. Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; the inspected sources identify no counted base for a size inference. Dense versus MoE is also undisclosed. PDF is an API input format converted to text and page images. Image generation is a hosted tool, not native o3 image output.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit on October 27 retains null total and active counts after reopening original OpenAI evidence, later OpenAI and Qwen model-team comparisons, and original empirical papers. No supported nominal count or counted-base inference was found; an explicitly estimated CVPR ~500B figure lacks count provenance and is not adopted. Explicit null count/source patch values added. The other 12 field assessments are preserved.
